cohort: Patients aged 18 years and above admitted to the operating theatre recovery room following major surgery at Bugando Medical Centre (BMC) from March 2019 to May 2019.
finding: The incidence of immediate post-anesthetic complications was 68.4%, with postoperative nausea and vomiting being the most common (43.5%), and ASA II classification, general anesthesia, and abdominal surgery were significantly associated with these complications.
followup_time: Immediate post-anesthetic period (time spent in recovery room)
